name: Bronte Callaghan
bio:
Bronte's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally training as a fine artist, she found herself drawn to the intricate detailing and vibrant colours of racing liveries. After an apprenticeship at a custom motorcycle shop, she transitioned to motorsport, quickly mastering the art of applying complex designs to high-performance vehicles. Bronte's meticulous approach and insistence on perfection have earned her a reputation for producing flawless finishes, making her a sought-after specialist.

At Elite Motorsport, Bronte is responsible for ensuring every car leaves the paint shop looking its best. Her keen eye for detail and unwavering commitment to quality mean she's not afraid to challenge designers or engineers if she believes the finish is compromised. While her demanding nature can sometimes ruffle feathers, her colleagues respect her expertise and appreciate her dedication to delivering exceptional results. Bronte's passion lies in pushing the boundaries of automotive artistry, constantly seeking new techniques and materials to enhance the visual impact of Elite Motorsport's vehicles.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often tied back in a practical braid.
physical.description: Bronte is of average height with a slender build and a smattering of freckles across her nose.

quirks: Insists on listening to classical music while working, believing it enhances her focus.
Always wears a pair of bright pink noise-cancelling headphones, even when not actively painting.
Has a collection of miniature racing car models displayed on her workbench, each representing a significant milestone in her career.
